scripts.build: node scripts/check-product.mjs && pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @noble-shapes/workbench build
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @noble-shapes/workbench typecheck && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.release:check: pnpm release:sync && pnpm test && node scripts/check-package-archives.mjs
scripts.release:pack: pnpm release:sync && pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && node scripts/pack-release.mjs
